preconditions: The form is submitted with an empty date.
title: Visible error is not associated with the field
description: The inline error is visible under the date field but the input has no aria-describedby and no aria-invalid state, so the message exists only visually.

relatedElements.note: Describes the field with the hint and the error and sets aria-invalid.

expectedBehaviour: The field is programmatically identified as invalid and its error message is part of the field's accessible description.
actualBehaviour: The input exposes neither aria-invalid nor a description that includes the error.
userImpact: Screen-reader users reach the field without hearing the error and cannot tell what needs correcting.

wcag.note: The error is identified in text but is not associated with the field programmatically.

detection.note: Automated scanners often detect this pattern, but the defect is defined by the missing association rather than by any specific tool rule.

manualTests: Submit the empty form, then move to the date field in forms mode and listen for the error.

assistiveTechnologyTests.procedure: Navigate to the target with the VoiceOver rotor and confirm what is announced.

assertions: The input has no aria-describedby and no aria-invalid after the error is shown.
tests: tests/subtle-defects.spec.js: keeps variant A errors unassociated, unfocused and linked to nothing

reviewStatus.note: A Playwright regression test preserves the defective behaviour and its control. That is automated reproduction, not a manual or assistive-technology observation.
